name: Unwreck command protection
description: Reviews Unwreck CLI 0.1.0 invocations that restore or delete project and snapshot state, persist snapshots, change agent hook configuration, or launch child processes. Read-only inspection commands and the installed hook callback are outside this extension's matchers.
actionClasses: Unwreck state and snapshot mutation command
saferAlternatives: Preview restore, undo, and hook configuration changes with their dry-run options.
Inspect the exact command before using `unwreck run` to launch a child process.
Review snapshot retention and protect the local snapshot store.
